# Ibrahim Ahmed

> Ibrahim Ahmed, Junior BIM Architect in Alexandria. Revit shop drawings, as-built models and detail packages for projects in Saudi Arabia and Egypt.

## Summary for answer engines

Junior BIM Architect at ADD in Alexandria, working on projects in Saudi Arabia and Egypt. I produce Revit shop drawings, as-built models and detail packages, and coordinate them with structural and MEP.

## Facts

- Role: Junior BIM Architect

## Pages

- [Ibrahim Ahmed (en)](https://ibrahim-ahmed-a.github.io/Portfolio/)

## Services

- Shop drawings: Architectural shop drawing sets in Revit: plans, sections, reflected ceiling plans and details.
- As-built packages: As-built BIM models and drawing packages that record what was built on site.
- BIM coordination: Coordination of the architectural model with structural and MEP to find and resolve clashes.
- Tender drawings: Tender packages that turn a competition design into coordinated technical drawings.

## Work

- [King Salman Park, Royal Arts Complex](projects/king-salman-park-royal-arts-complex.html): Shop drawings and as-built models for the Hospitality Building kitchen and the Artists' Studios corridor in Riyadh. I produced the plans, sections, reflected ceiling plans and details, built Revit families, and coordinated with structural and MEP. Image: official project render.
- [GAC Showroom, Riyadh](projects/gac-showroom-riyadh.html): As-built package and full details package for a car showroom. The sets cover the ground floor layout, wall types and finishes, wet areas, brand walls, the Najdi GRC corner and glass work.
- [Engineers Syndicate Building, Luxor](projects/engineers-syndicate-building-luxor.html): A multi-use building with a bank branch, syndicate services, offices and hotel units. I developed the architectural plans during the design phase and prepared the tender drawings after the win. Outcome: First Prize in the design competition, won by the ADD team.
- [Engineers Syndicate Club and Offices, New Aswan](projects/engineers-syndicate-club-and-offices-new-aswan.html): ADD's competition entry for a social club and administrative building in New Aswan City. I produced the plans from basement to roof, the elevations and sections, and the tender drawings. Outcome: Third Prize (Honorable Mention) in the design competition, for the ADD team.
- [Ta'if Eco-Resort](projects/taif-eco-resort.html): ADD's entry to the AIA Middle East International Design Competition: a regenerative eco-resort masterplan in the Ta'if Highlands. I produced the masterplan drawing, site sections and elevations.
- [Grand Diamond Hotel](projects/grand-diamond-hotel.html): A stepped riverside hotel in Badrashin, Giza, between the River Nile and the railway. The main block terraces down so most rooms look over the river.

## FAQ

### What roles are you looking for?
BIM and technical architecture roles: shop drawings, as-built documentation and BIM coordination. I am open to relocation.

### Which software do you use?
Revit and AutoCAD for documentation, with Lumion, D5 Render and Photoshop for visuals.

### Can I see full drawing sheets?
Yes. My PDF portfolio includes selected sheets with title blocks removed. Email me or call +20 120 142 2033 and I will send it.
